sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goals WHERE match_id = 80 AND player_name = 'Harry KANE'
SELECT attendance FROM matches WHERE match_id = 80
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE match_id = 80 AND card_type = 'Y'
SELECT h.team_name, a.team_name FROM matches m JOIN teams h ON m.home_team_id = h.team_id JOIN teams a ON m.away_team_id = a.team_id WHERE m.match_id = 80
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c JOIN matches m ON c.match_id = m.match_id JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id = s.stadium_id WHERE s.stadium_name = 'Atlanta Stadium' AND c.card_type = 'Y'
SELECT stage, COUNT(*) FROM matches GROUP BY stage
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) FROM goals g JOIN teams t ON g.scoring_team_id = t.team_id WHERE g.match_id = 81 GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m.went_to_extra_time) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id = s.stadium_id WHERE s.stadium_name = 'Atlanta Stadium'

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id = m.match_id JOIN teams t ON g.scoring_team_id = t.team_id WHERE m.went_to_extra_time = 1 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, n FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM c) ORDER BY team_name

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(g.goal_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id), 2) FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id = s.stadium_id LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.match_id = m.match_id WHERE s.country = 'USA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goals WHERE match_id = 82
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineups WHERE match_id = 80 AND is_starter = 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendance)) FROM matches WHERE stage = 'Round of 32'
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) FROM cards c JOIN teams t ON c.team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.match_id = 81 AND c.card_type = 'Y' GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name
SELECT s.stadium_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id = s.stadium_id WHERE s.country = 'USA' GROUP BY s.stadium_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, s.stadium_name
